description: Replace the title, content, theme, byline, slug or expiry of a page you own. Omitted fields are kept. A new slug (Pro, or a minted page) changes the URL: the old link then shows 'revoked' and can't be reused. Minted pages stay permanent (expires_in_hours is ignored). Requires an API key (guest pages can't be edited).

page_id.description: The page_id returned by publish_page or list_pages.

slug.description: New custom URL slug (Pro or minted pages). Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens.

name: update_page
